claims.claim: up to 86 % of annual DOC export from forested catchments occurs in storms and snowmelt (Raymond & Saiers 2010, as cited by Klug et al. 2012)
claims.note: Full text not obtained. The publisher's abstract (not a confirmation) states the 86 % as an estimate for 30 small eastern-US forested watersheds without wetlands (5,176 DOC and discharge measurements), calls it 'a conservative estimate', and adds that events above 1.38 cm/day, 4.8 % of the annual hydrograph, carry 57 % of annual DOC flux. The abstract's wording is an estimate of 86 %, not 'up to 86 %' ('up to' is Klug et al.'s phrasing). Klug et al. 2012's relay itself was checked by another reader (docs/paper/evidence/Klug_etal_2012.json: accurate relay).
